# Paired-AOI overlay on w16/r4/mean alpha=.25 base

Base = source trainaug-r2 cohort/year route + 0.25 * leakage-safe visible 16-day same-crop peer residual mean (numeric AOI radius 4). Paired correction blends base with affine peer prediction: (1-w)*base + w*peer; missing peers fall back to base.
